strings: m_c has always felt the emotions {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates feel along with them. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have hyperempathy.
Some autistic cats have higher empathy than normal, and m_c seems to be one of them.
When r_c0 expresses frustration at something, m_c becomes increasingly agitated at it along with {PRONOUN/r_c0/object}.
At r_c0's crying, m_c breaks into sobs along with {PRONOUN/r_c0/object}.
